fee_notes: Royalty is 6.0% of Gross Revenues, due on the 10th of each month. Advertising Contribution is 0.5% of Gross Revenues for the National Materials Fund; franchisor reserves the right to increase this to 1.0% of Gross Revenues. Local Advertising Commitment is an additional 4.0% of Gross Revenues (minimum), spent on pre-approved local advertising. POS Maintenance Fee ranges from $193 to $369 per month, paid directly to vendor. Biennial Convention registration fee is $1,200 per person. Transfer Fee is $10,000 ($2,000 per Center for unopened Centers under Multi-Unit Agreement), subject to annual CPI increases. Transferee Training Fee is $2,500. Renewal Fee is $0 to $5,000. Late charge is $25 per late payment. Additional Training/Assistance Fee is $500 per trainer per day. Interest on overdue amounts is the lesser of 1.5% per month or the highest rate allowed by law. Tech fee (POS) is not a single fixed monthly amount but a range; captured in fee_notes rather than tech_fee_monthly due to range structure.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty(2) | 6.0% of Gross Revenues | Due on the 10th day of each month | The "Royalty" is based on "Gross Revenues" during the previous month. Your Royalty is an ongoing payment that allows you to use the Marks and the intellectual property of the System and pays for our ongoing support and assistance.
Advertising Contribution(2) | 0.5% of Gross Revenues | Same as the Royalty | This contribution is used for a system-wide "National Materials Fund" for our use in promoting and building the SpeeDee brand. We reserve the right to increase the required contribution to 1% of Gross Revenues.
Local Advertising Commitment | 4.0% of Gross Revenues | As incurred | You must spend a minimum of 4 percent of your total monthly Gross Revenues on local advertising that has been pre-approved by us.
Local and Regional Advertising Cooperatives | Established by cooperative members | Established by cooperative members | Payments to a Local or Regional Advertising Cooperative will be credited to your Local Advertising commitment.
Point of Sale System (POS) Maintenance Fee | Ranges between $193 to $369 per month | As Agreed | This monthly fee is paid directly to the vendor. The cost may increase if you elect additional modules or services that the vendor offers.
Convention and Other Meeting Fee(1) | Varies. The current charge for registration for our biennial convention is $1,200 per person. | As incurred | You are required to attend our biennial conventions held once every two years, and the registration fee for the biennial convention will be charged even if you do not attend.
Audit Expenses | Cost of audit and inspection, any understated amounts, and any related accounting and legal expenses | On demand | You will be required to pay this if an audit reveals that you understated monthly Gross Revenues by more than 2%.
Transfer Fee | $10,000 | $1,000 non-refundable deposit at time of transfer application submittal with the remainder due at time of the approved transfer | Payable in connection with the transfer of your SpeeDee Center. If you are transferring an unopened Center under a Multi-Unit Agreement, the fee will be $2,000 per Center.
Transferee Training Fee | $2,500 | Prior to consummation of transfer
Renewal Fee(3) | $0 to $5,000 | When you sign the then-current Franchise Agreement
Interest | Lesser of 1.5% per month or highest rate of interest allowed by law | As incurred
Late Charges | $25 | As incurred
Insufficient Funds Fee | An amount equal to the fee imposed against us | As incurred
Additional Training or Assistance Fees | $500 per trainer per day | As incurred
